name: deputy
description: Deputize cheap models. Claude stays the sheriff. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (thinking on) gives Claude second opinions, reviews its changes for bugs, and can take bulk work, while Claude decides and verifies.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: accuracy (recommended): Claude writes all code, Deputy only gives second opinions and reviews. balanced: Deputy also takes low-risk mechanical work. savings: Deputy takes most coding work.

deepinfra_api_key.title: DeepInfra API key
deepinfra_api_key.description: Your key from deepinfra.com (Dashboard > API Keys). Stored in your system's secure storage. Leave empty to use the DEEPINFRA_API_KEY environment variable instead.

thinking.title: Thinking level
thinking.description: How hard DeepSeek thinks. high is the recommended default; max is slower and costs more.
